author: Brandjuh
name: CuffStarboard
short: The commendation board: enough star reactions repost a message to the board channel.
description: The commendation board: react with enough ⭐ and the message is reposted to the configured board channel — community-curated highlights, each message boarded once.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores the IDs of messages that were posted to the starboard. It does not store any personal end user data.
